name: Dheere Dheere Se
description: Tragedy follows a grieving widow Bhawana as she navigates through the hardships of life. In pursuit of a better future, she must brave against the odds.

videos.title: Meet a Hopeful Bhawana
videos.overview: The death of her husband turns Bhawana’s life upside down. Despite the odds, she remains hopeful and seeks a better future for her daughter. Will she succeed?

videos.title: Raghav Returns to Ujjain
videos.overview: After fifteen years, Raghav returns to Ujjain and learns about Deepak's death. Bhavana decides to return the cheque to the insurance company and change the beneficiary.

videos.title: Raghav Meets Bhavana
videos.overview: Raghav and Bhavana cross paths at the market and belittle each other for their inability. After learning the truth about one another, they regret their bad conduct.

videos.title: Bhawana Faces the Heat
videos.overview: Bhawana strives to make rectifications at the insurance office by herself. Upon returning home, the family members unleash their fury at Bhawana.

videos.title: Bhawana Faces Trouble
videos.overview: Raghav and Bhawana meet at a nearby temple and recall the happenings of their first-day encounter. Bhawana faces trouble in convincing the authorities of the insurance office.

videos.title: Raghav Helps Bhawana
videos.overview: Bhawana faces problems in the registrar's office, Raghav gives a stern reply to the officer and helps Bhawana out. Further, they apologise to each other for their past behaviour.
